Companion Animal Travel Desk booking basics

Aurelia Skyways moves passengers between skyports, and our Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the animal part of the trip steady from booking through pickup. Start by sharing the animal type, size, carrier details, and any care notes as early as possible. That lets the team check fit, route limits, and the handoff plan without last-minute scrambles.

For reptiles, the desk reviews the required fee before the trip is confirmed. <<FACT F060>> Bring only the approved enclosure, keep the lid secure, and make sure the setup is clean, ventilated, and easy to inspect. If the animal needs special temperature support, tell us during booking so the planner can record the right handling notes.

For larger dogs, the desk also checks age eligibility before travel is accepted. <<FACT F075>> The animal should be comfortable around unfamiliar people, standard carrier routines, and normal airport noise. Use a sturdy leash or carrier at drop-off, and keep water, food, and medication packed in a simple, accessible way.

At the skyport, follow the animal check-in lane and keep your paperwork ready. The staff may ask to verify the carrier, confirm the reservation, and review the release point at arrival. If you are traveling with more than one animal, expect separate handling notes for each one.

After arrival, collect the animal promptly and inspect the carrier before leaving the pickup area. If anything looks off, tell the nearest staff member right away so the issue can be logged and handled.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways support line or ask the front counter team for a callback.
